name: UX Design Strategy
tagline: Complete 35-page UX Design Strategy display system with its own typography, composition and layout vocabulary.

palette.description: Source-specific colors retained in native text, shapes, tables and image treatments; not normalized across templates.

typography.style: DM Sans display with DM Sans body; original source font-family roles, declared weights, sizes and frames retained. Original unmodified font files are embedded with their own licenses; font versions are recorded. No common font substitution.

best_for: UX strategy presentations connecting research, before-and-after analysis, roadmap planning, evidence and facilitated workshop activities.
avoid_for: Very short brand teasers, purely photographic storytelling, or claims that require live workshop collaboration.

source_inspiration.name: True to Form — UX Design Strategy
source_inspiration.notes: Independent native implementation following all 35 public source pages, order and source block geometry. Fonts and images are bundled for the user's clarified public display-library scope. No affirmative blanket third-party relicense is claimed. Preserve author/source attribution and the separate font/media notices. Source image bytes were re-encoded for size; their crops/filters remain in CSS.
